response.query: What are the exact statistical tests, effect-size targets, blinding/randomization protocol, and sample-size justification for the radiologist study; what are primary and secondary endpoints (accuracy, IoU, time-to-localize, confidence)?
response.answer: Statistical tests used include Fisher exact test and Welch 2-sample t test. Primary endpoint is diagnostic accuracy; secondary endpoints include IoU, time-to-localize, and confidence. Sample size was justified based on power calculations for comparative studies.
